title: Kilvarra Statistics Office: usual residents of each district on 30 June 2026 for the 2027/28 grant determination

sources.origin: generated for this task by simulating the processes that make the files: Kilvarra's people from mid-2021 to mid-2026 (births, deaths, emigration and immigration, moves between districts, students, the Defence Forces), the Health Service's register (registration, deregistration, re-registration, list maintenance), the Statistics Office's 2026 coverage survey, its follow-up and clerical review, the border, civil registration and education returns. Kilvarra, its agencies, places and people are invented.
